reply_text: I replied to Dana in a thread on their message in #north-team. I confirmed I'd noted their 1:1s are on Thursday this week and offered to update calendar invites or tell anyone if they want. I didn't change anything, because it was just a heads-up and they didn't ask for any action. GBrain had nothing about this week's 1:1s, but its search was running in keyword-only mode, so that isn't proof there's nothing there.
